rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a government agency or administrative organization.

example.english: The government agency has approved this project.
example.traditional: 政府機構已經批准咗呢項計劃。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gei1 kau3 ji5 ging1 pai1 zeon2 zo2 ni1 hong6 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this for a business that represents or handles matters for another company or person.

example.english: We hired an agency to handle the export documents.
example.traditional: 我哋搵咗間代理公司幫手處理出口文件。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wan2 zo2 gaan1 doi6 lei5 gung1 si1 bong1 sau2 cyu2 lei5 ceot1 hau2 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this when agency means the ability to make independent choices and act freely.

example.english: Students need agency to make their own decisions.
example.traditional: 學生有自主性，先可以真正為自己作決定。
example.jyutping: hok6 saang1 jau5 zi6 zyu2 sing3 sin1 ho2 ji5 zan1 zing3 wai6 zi6 gei2 zok3 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use this for the abstract capacity or power to act rather than merely be acted upon.

example.english: In this project, employees’ agency is very important.
example.traditional: 喺呢個計劃入面，員工嘅能動性好重要。
example.jyutping: hai2 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jap6 min6 jyun4 gung1 ge3 nang4 dung6 sing3 hou2 zung6 jiu3
